feature_description: Reject naive datetimes at every research boundary.
acceptance_test: Naive datetime fixtures fail validation.

feature_description: Record event available ingested and revision time independently.
acceptance_test: All four clocks survive round trip.

feature_description: Permit evidence only when every known-time clock is visible at as_of.
acceptance_test: Future-known evidence is rejected.

feature_description: Represent one evidence item with provenance timing and policy metadata.
acceptance_test: Mutation is rejected and serialization is stable.

feature_description: Derive stable evidence IDs and SHA-256 hashes from canonical content.
acceptance_test: Equal content produces equal IDs and tampering is detected.

feature_description: Recompute supplied IDs and hashes before accepting API output as input.
acceptance_test: Tampered identifiers fail validation.

feature_description: Normalize A-share limit-up facts into the shared evidence schema.
acceptance_test: Frozen limit-up input yields validated evidence.

feature_description: Normalize intraday failed-limit events.
acceptance_test: Frozen broken-board input yields validated evidence.

feature_description: Normalize board height and consecutive limit events.
acceptance_test: Frozen board-count input yields validated evidence.

feature_description: Normalize company disclosure evidence with provenance.
acceptance_test: Disclosure fixture passes schema validation.

feature_description: Normalize theme membership and catalyst observations.
acceptance_test: Theme and catalyst fixtures remain distinguishable.

feature_description: Normalize capital-flow observations with quality flags.
acceptance_test: Capital fixture produces a traceable snapshot.

feature_description: Persist immutable run manifests in SQLite WAL mode.
acceptance_test: Repeated equal writes are idempotent and conflicts fail.

feature_description: Persist and retrieve immutable decisions by run.
acceptance_test: Decision round trip preserves the stable ID.

feature_description: Append and enumerate immutable checkpoint digests.
acceptance_test: Checkpoint order and digest survive restart.
notes: Record persistence only; graph resume is outside v1.

feature_description: Store evidence snapshots in local Parquet partitions.
acceptance_test: Appended evidence is queryable after reopen.

feature_description: Query Parquet evidence using point-in-time filters.
acceptance_test: Query excludes evidence unavailable at as_of.

feature_description: Declare request batch metadata and explicit failure semantics.
acceptance_test: Enabled providers satisfy the common contract.

feature_description: Separate authentication configuration response rate-limit and upstream failures.
acceptance_test: A failed provider never appears as successful empty data.

feature_description: Read user-owned CSV JSON JSONL and Parquet files.
acceptance_test: All supported formats produce equivalent batches.

feature_description: Fetch Tushare data only with a user-supplied token.
acceptance_test: Frozen HTTP responses pass and missing token fails.

feature_description: Expose an optional allowlisted research adapter.
acceptance_test: Allowlisted datasets work and unknown datasets fail.
notes: AKShare and source data retain upstream terms.

feature_description: Declare credentials caching redistribution freshness and rate-limit boundaries.
acceptance_test: Policy fields are mandatory and extra fields fail.

feature_description: Define typed context signal and rationale outputs.
acceptance_test: A conforming agent participates in a cycle.

feature_description: Analyze market-event evidence deterministically.
acceptance_test: Market evidence yields a cited signal.

feature_description: Analyze theme catalyst and disclosure evidence.
acceptance_test: Theme evidence routes to the theme agent.

feature_description: Analyze capital observations deterministically.
acceptance_test: Capital evidence routes to the capital agent.

feature_description: Route only agents supported by the supplied evidence families.
acceptance_test: Unsupported agents do not run.

feature_description: Accept only schema-validated model outputs.
acceptance_test: Invalid model output is never returned as a signal.

feature_description: Retry invalid structured output within a fixed budget.
acceptance_test: Valid retry succeeds and exhausted budget fails explicitly.

feature_description: Expose PIT evidence lookup without mutation capability.
acceptance_test: Tool result contains only visible evidence.

feature_description: Provide reproducible research without requiring an LLM.
acceptance_test: Same inputs produce byte-equivalent research outputs.

feature_description: Represent direction strength confidence horizon evidence and invalidation.
acceptance_test: Directional signals require evidence and valid bounds.

feature_description: Represent insufficient evidence as a first-class non-directional outcome.
acceptance_test: Abstention requires a reason and zero strength.

feature_description: Record agent outputs routing risk and final action.
acceptance_test: All referenced signal IDs reconcile.

feature_description: Pass reduce or block aggregate research signals.
acceptance_test: Risk flags can block a final action.

feature_description: Capture code config providers models prompts seed environment and lifecycle.
acceptance_test: Terminal lifecycle and artifact digests validate.

feature_description: Return the same completed run or reject conflicting immutable inputs.
acceptance_test: Equal rerun succeeds and conflicting run ID fails.

feature_description: Append and inspect decision summaries across process restarts.
acceptance_test: Completed research survives SDK/API restart and conflicting replacement is rejected.

feature_description: Resume after the last completed agent without repeating successful work.
acceptance_test: An injected interruption resumes at the next agent.
notes: Operational state is separate from immutable ledgers.

feature_description: Reject recovery state when immutable inputs or graph shape change.
acceptance_test: Changed config digest or agent graph raises RunConflictError.

feature_description: Use the same research engine for live replay and backtest modes.
acceptance_test: Mode changes do not fork decision logic.

feature_description: Load a versioned 60-session 300-event corpus.
acceptance_test: Corpus contains 60 sessions and 300 unique cases.

feature_description: Execute each replay case twice and compare results.
acceptance_test: All frozen cases replay deterministically.

feature_description: Reject replay cases with evidence unavailable at decision time.
acceptance_test: Known look-ahead violations remain zero.

feature_description: Model T+1 board lots suspensions and limit-lock tradability.
acceptance_test: Forbidden buys and sells return explicit reasons.

feature_description: Model commission minimum commission transfer fee and seller stamp tax.
acceptance_test: Buy and sell cost fixtures match configured rules.
notes: Rates are configuration not legal advice.

feature_description: Compare observed return with benchmark and transaction cost.
acceptance_test: Net active return reconciles exactly.

feature_description: Allocate net active return across named additive terms.
acceptance_test: Attribution sum equals net active return.

feature_description: Maintain cash, acquisition lots, marks, fees, realized PnL, T+1, and exposure clamps.
acceptance_test: Buy/sell transitions reconcile cash, FIFO basis, costs, T+1, and exposure limits.
notes: Long-only research simulator; no broker execution.

feature_description: Expose health evidence research replay validation market and theme routes.
acceptance_test: OpenAPI lists every v1 route and golden flow passes.

feature_description: Expose local evidence research replay and outcome operations.
acceptance_test: SDK completes the frozen golden path.

feature_description: Build evidence from user-owned files.
acceptance_test: CLI and API emit equal evidence.

feature_description: Run research from serialized evidence.
acceptance_test: CLI emits a cited decision.

feature_description: Execute a frozen replay corpus.
acceptance_test: CLI returns replay statistics.

feature_description: Provide evidence decision replay and attribution panels.
acceptance_test: Desktop and mobile golden flows pass without console errors.

feature_description: Show loading error empty and insufficient-evidence states.
acceptance_test: Each non-happy state is visible and actionable.

feature_description: Publish versioned schemas for stable research records.
acceptance_test: Generated schemas equal checked-in files.

feature_description: Call compatible structured-output endpoints without persisting credential values.
acceptance_test: Schema is sent, JSON is validated, missing credentials fail before network, and secrets are absent from metadata.
notes: Supports HTTPS and explicit localhost HTTP endpoints.

feature_description: Resolve runtime and development dependencies with uv.lock.
acceptance_test: Locked install succeeds on supported Python versions.

feature_description: Resolve React and toolchain dependencies with pnpm lockfile.
acceptance_test: Frozen install lint test and build pass.

feature_description: Run Python gates on Windows and Linux and web/container gates on Linux.
acceptance_test: Workflow includes locked installs tests lint types builds audits and replay.

feature_description: Build the web and Python runtime into a non-root image.
acceptance_test: Container health endpoint and web root return 200.

feature_description: Keep evidence and ledgers under /data across restart.
acceptance_test: Evidence ID remains queryable after container restart.

feature_description: Drop capabilities enforce no-new-privileges and use a read-only root.
acceptance_test: Compose config contains all hardening controls.

feature_description: Set CSP frame MIME referrer permission and opener policies.
acceptance_test: Health and static responses include required headers.
notes: TLS and HSTS belong at the reverse proxy.

feature_description: Reject declared request bodies above the configured maximum.
acceptance_test: Oversized requests return HTTP 413.

feature_description: Reject secrets runtime databases installers and oversized Git objects.
acceptance_test: Publication scan reports zero blockers.

feature_description: Audit locked Python and Node dependencies before release.
acceptance_test: No known high or critical vulnerability remains.
notes: Registry availability is an external dependency.

feature_description: Publish source under MIT with third-party notices.
acceptance_test: GitHub recognizes the license and release tag matches source.

feature_description: Do not connect to brokerage order endpoints in v1.
acceptance_test: Repository contains no broker credential or order submission path.

feature_description: Exclude short-selling order semantics from the A-share v1 research path.
acceptance_test: Execution model exposes no short or cover action.
notes: Not appropriate for the v1 target boundary.

feature_description: Do not redistribute commercial or user-licensed provider data.
acceptance_test: Repository and releases contain no restricted raw dataset.

feature_description: Reject any design that commits or returns real API credentials.
acceptance_test: Tracked-file scan finds no secret value.

feature_description: Visual authoring of arbitrary agent graphs.
acceptance_test: Future version requires schema-safe graph validation.
notes: Avoids copying unstable upstream WIP surfaces.

feature_description: Persist batches and item states in SQLite WAL.
acceptance_test: Submitted tasks and item results survive store reopen.

feature_description: Execute batch items with a declared worker ceiling.
acceptance_test: Worker count is validated between 1 and 32.

feature_description: Persist item lifecycle events and cooperatively cancel queued work.
acceptance_test: Progress is append ordered and queued items cancel explicitly.
notes: Running provider calls are not force-killed.

feature_description: Requeue process-interrupted running items while preserving terminal work.
acceptance_test: Restart requeues only running items.

feature_description: Resolve context output reasoning structured-output and usage capabilities.
acceptance_test: Duplicate registrations fail and secrets are absent.

feature_description: Retry transient 408 429 and 5xx transport failures with bounded exponential delay.
acceptance_test: 429 retries while 401 fails immediately.

feature_description: Persist provider-reported tokens attempts and configured estimated cost.
acceptance_test: Usage survives reopen and reconciles configured prices.
notes: Estimate is not a provider invoice.

feature_description: Fetch licensed A-share data through explicit auth PIT revision rate-limit and error contracts.
acceptance_test: Frozen contract preserves clocks and classifies auth rate limit and upstream errors.
notes: Server URL credentials and data rights are user supplied.

feature_description: Report return benchmark active return turnover capacity and exposure attribution.
acceptance_test: Cash and reported metrics reconcile across multiple dates.

acceptance_test: Equal replay is idempotent and conflicting order ID fails.

feature_description: Filter and rank verified research results by confidence direction action and risk.
acceptance_test: Results are deterministically sorted and retain decision IDs.

feature_description: Create update list and remove tagged subject observations.
acceptance_test: Entries survive reopen and remove explicitly.
